I wrote `main.wj`. I ran it in the interpreter on both examples combined into one input, and its output matched the expected output for both.

I didn't run `wj build`, as instructed, so the compiled path is untested.

The parser reads each line character by character and tracks whether it is inside quotes. A doubled `""` inside quotes becomes a literal `"`. An empty line gives one empty field. Oth
